title: VisitNote
description: Structured note extracted from a primary-care visit transcript. Every field is required; use the explicit 'not mentioned' values instead of guessing.

chief_complaint.description: Main reason for the visit in a few words, or null if not stated.

symptoms.description: All symptoms discussed, including the ones behind the main complaint (e.g. 'cough' for a cough visit) and ones the patient explicitly denies, with status 'denied'.

medications.description: Medications discussed for this patient, with what the clinician decided.

dose.description: Dose as stated, e.g. '500 mg twice daily'. Null if no dose was said.

tests_ordered.description: Lab work, imaging or other tests ordered at this visit.

referrals.description: Specialties or services the patient is referred to.

interval_days.description: Days stated with the follow-up (1 week = 7, 1 month = 30). For 'scheduled', days until the visit. For 'as_needed', the window the clinician gave ('come back if not better in a week' = 7). Null if no time was given.

follow_up.description: When the patient should be seen again. 'scheduled': a visit is planned. 'as_needed': the patient comes back only if something happens (e.g. not improving, or worse).
